# Copilot instructions

See [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root — the shared agent
guide for this repository (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or otherwise). The
maintainer is not a software engineer, so the AI is the safety net: read
`CLAUDE.md` in full, then `tests/requirements/README.md`, before considering
any task done. The requirements test suite is a permanent gating check, not
optional documentation — and since no CI workflow or branch protection
enforces it yet (see `tests/requirements/AUTOMATION.md`), you are the only
thing enforcing it.
